adjudication.rationale: In config/routes.rb the diff adds `resources :embeddable_hosts` under the `/admin` namespace without any `only:`/`except:` limitation. By default this creates GET routes for `index`, `show`, `new`, and `edit`, but the new `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` only defines `create`, `update`, and `destroy`. Any request to `/admin/embeddable_hosts` (or `/admin/embeddable_hosts/:id`, etc.) using those GET routes would hit missing actions and raise an `ActionNotFound`/500, so the finding is directly supported by the diff.
